top_signals.title: US awards Raytheon $22.9 billion deal to boost Tomahawk output
top_signals.summary: The U.S. military, scrambling to rebuild depleted stocks of high-tech weaponry, awarded Raytheon $22.9 billion to dramatically boost Tomahawk production.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong Exchanges Non-Equity Push Seen Key for Stock Boost
top_signals.summary: With record trading volumes and new listings providing little boost for shares of Hong Kong Exchanges & Clearing Ltd., analysts are increasingly looking for a jolt from the company’s expansion of non-equity business.

top_signals.title: Singapore casino’s winning streak puts pressure on losing rival
top_signals.summary: Marina Bay Sands' casino revenues for the first half of 2026 topped $2.1 billion, while Resorts World Sentosa's comparable numbers were less than a third of that.
